name: BurnsBuild burnToHolder / receiveRewards
summary: BurnsBuild values surrendered tokens from a mutable AMM spot quote and immediately distributes reflection rewards. Flash-funded reserve/liquidity changes inflate burn credit and native reward withdrawals.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

ageReset.description: Direct BurnsBuild deployment. Main-token selections change asset exposure; both selected token implementations provide identical guarded token/native delivery without correcting Build spot-credit accounting.

limitations: Direct runtime/deployment reproduced in source-8; the earliest successful distorted-credit exercise across multi-transaction users remains unresolved, so this provisional seed anchor may change.

Partial scope/invariant review. Etherscan V2 getLogs(Build, ReceiveReward(address,uint256,uint256), [35848296,125820045], pages 1-2 offset 1000) returns 1477 events/unique receipts, 1287 callers, last block 49363990. eth_getTransactionReceipt for every hash finds 1475 direct EOA calls (receipt.from=event account, receipt.to=Build) and two nested payouts: source-1 and source-6. This is a candidate filter, not exclusion of multi-transaction EOA manipulation. Source-6 at 42768285 uses a WBNB flashswap, Burns pair liquidity changes and 40 burnToHolder calls: Main sends Build 28126583386015161560 wei, Build pays 2005198363000000000 wei to 0x092de66c8efa1fc00c63325d35ee805b48a145182, Main receives 827694772197650724 wei in tax/swapback. Sender 0x88ee7c8b8dfc3c4e34832761b66e9b13c428367d/helper 0xc3899c4134415255de868f693261b95e211963c2. Seed prestateTracer diff shows Main native 334456317385659142067 ->45097795719674116962 wei and Build 5342952216591049391 ->28177878596250191458; callTracer reconciles internal custody and actual311621391006000000000 wei payout without block ambiguity. The entire initial Main native reserve predates this transaction; 45097795719674116962 wei tax/swapback arrives after payout and is not automatically deducted from gross loss. Seed pair 0x928cd66dfa268c69a37be93bf7759dc8ee676bf8 slot8 prestate reserves are Burns=2457534138952729676771278, WBNB=366044769775505086857. Burn quantities34274592372516145012920 and246429928729346743564685 quote5022496465590748394 and33284237101124260037 wei on those pre-manipulation reserves (9975/10000 fee), versus actual manipulated quotes50000000000000000000 and284456317385659142067. Credits divide quotes by1e9; canRewards caps native withdrawal at twice total credited burn, yet actual311621391006000000000 wei exceeds even twice the38306733566715008431 wei pre-manipulation quote sum. Old/new Main source burnToholder is identical guarded transfer/native delivery; pointer changes select asset exposure without correcting Build valuation/reflection branch. Unresolved: full direct-EOA multi-transaction manipulation population and separation of legitimate burn/reward entitlement from erroneous spot-priced credit, including redistribution rights to other participants. Next: join every caller's historical burn credits to Burns-pair buys/sells/liquidity changes and calculate funding/entitlement-adjusted episode loss; do not classify all1475 direct payouts as theft or assert full USD from the two nested payouts alone.

Partial identity/age review. eth_getTransactionReceipt(source-4) returns contractAddress=Build, block35848296:index50; eth_getBlockByNumber gives timestamp1707072402. eth_getCode(Build,35848296/35858189/35858190/42768285) hashes identically to the structured codeArtifact. OwnershipTransferred logs before seed show only constructor owner0xf59fc943f22e976bc74b29fffe1fc711dfab5600, whose eth_getCode at35858190 is empty; complete preincident normal history therefore covers owner-only pointer writes. Owner renounces at35859560, preventing subsequent owner-only changes. Old/new Main getsourcecode burnToholder implementations identically require the selected Build caller, launch and sufficient token balance, then transfer the surrendered tokens and native quoted amount. Main is custody, not an independently defective accounting artifact. Main-token selection/airdrop launch change exposure/availability; Build spot-based credit/reflection remains the same. Deployment-to-seed29726seconds is reproduced, but complete earlier distorted-credit attribution and full episode scope remain unresolved in source-7; no semantic promotion.

limitations: Source-5/source-7 reproduce two nested campaigns and quantified spot-credit distortion; 1285 direct-user credit/manipulation histories and participant redistribution rights remain unresolved.
